notes: Multi Studio version 2.2.6: **Native Apple Silicon Metal GPU Acceleration for Local Whisper**: Upgraded the local Whisper engine (`whisper-rs` 0.16.0) to fully support modern Apple Silicon GPUs (M1, M2, M3, M4 Max). Fixed a runtime Metal shader compilation error that caused Whisper to silently fall back to 100% CPU compute, unlocking full Metal 3 GPU hardware acceleration, noticeably cooler laptop temperatures, and significantly faster transcription speeds., **Metal Flash Attention Optimization**: Enabled native Flash Attention for the offline Whisper context, optimizing GPU memory bandwidth and reducing power consumption during transcription.
